# IBM Newsroom

> IBM's official newsroom providing press releases, announcements, and corporate communications across artificial intelligence, quantum computing, hybrid cloud, and enterprise technology.

The IBM Newsroom serves as the central hub for IBM's corporate communications, featuring breaking news, executive leadership information, and media resources. It covers key strategic areas including AI, quantum computing, cloud infrastructure, and industry partnerships, with content organized by topic and global regions.

## Key Topics

- Artificial Intelligence
- Quantum Computing
- Hybrid Cloud
- Enterprise Technology
- watsonx.ai
- watsonx.governance
- IBM Research
- Industry Partnerships

- IBM Cloud
- Corporate Announcements
- Press Releases
- Executive Leadership
- Social Impact

## Core Newsroom & Leadership

- [IBM Newsroom](https://newsroom.ibm.com): IBM Newsroom homepage with latest press releases and announcements
- [IBM Newsroom Index](https://newsroom.ibm.com/index.php): IBM Newsroom index page featuring corporate news and press releases
- [About IBM](https://newsroom.ibm.com/about-IBM): IBM company overview and boilerplate information for press
- [Executive Leadership](https://newsroom.ibm.com/executive-bios): IBM executive leadership bios including CEO Arvind Krishna
- [Global Newsrooms](https://newsroom.ibm.com/global-news-room): IBM global newsroom directory and regional office locations

## Technology & Innovation News

- [Latest Announcements](https://newsroom.ibm.com/announcements): Latest IBM announcements on quantum computing, AI, and partnerships
- [Artificial Intelligence News](https://newsroom.ibm.com/latest-news-artificial-intelligence): IBM artificial intelligence news and corporate AI announcements
- [Quantum Computing & Innovation](https://newsroom.ibm.com/latest-news-research-and-innovation): IBM research and innovation news archive with latest announcements
- [Hybrid Cloud News](https://newsroom.ibm.com/latest-news-hybrid-cloud): IBM hybrid cloud news and industry partnership announcements
- [Think 2025 Conference](https://newsroom.ibm.com/think-2025): Think 2025 conference coverage and IBM technology announcements
- [Charles H. Bennett Turing Award](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2026-03-18-ibm-fellow-and-quantum-pioneer-charles-h-bennett-receives-a-m-turing-award-computings-highest-honor): Charles H. Bennett wins A.M. Turing Award for quantum computing research

## Corporate News & Strategy

- [Corporate News](https://newsroom.ibm.com/latest-news-corporate): IBM corporate news and company announcements archive
- [Mergers & Acquisitions](https://newsroom.ibm.com/mergers-and-acquisitions): IBM M&A announcements including Confluent, HashiCorp, DataStax deals
- [Social Impact](https://newsroom.ibm.com/latest-new-social-impact): IBM social impact news and corporate responsibility announcements
